video_title: LeBron's Choice Could Come Out of Nowhere | Rachel Nichols & Chris Mannix

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James is making decisions based on personal preference, not money
quotes.excerpt: We are seeing a player who is not concerned about money, whose contract will not affect the books
quotes.quote: We are seeing a player who is not concerned about money, whose contract will not affect the books of whatever team that he signs with. Make a decision purely based on what his personal preferences are. At this point, I proudly say I have no idea. I was sitting in Vegas having conversations with a lot of different people over the course of the last few days, and I can tell you they have no idea. Some of these people are from teams who are in the mix for LeBron James, told me they have no idea. Whatever he decides to do, and whenever he decides to do it, it will absolutely come out of nowhere for most people.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: League executives have no inside information on LeBron James's next team
quotes.excerpt: Nobody has additional information. When someone says, oh, I think it's kind of trending toward Cleveland

text_blocks.speaker: Rachel Nichols
text_blocks.text: All of these aggregation stories where you see it's trending toward Cleveland, or people around the league think it's Cleveland's to lose, conversations being had around the league between league executives with each other, with reporters, are the exact same conversation you and I are having. Nobody has additional information. When someone says, oh, I think it's kind of trending toward Cleveland because of course where else can you see him going, it's such a good story, that is their opinion on how good a story it is and whether that would appeal to LeBron James. It has nothing to do about whether his decision is actually trending toward Cleveland.

text_blocks.speaker: Chris Mannix
text_blocks.text: From the executive side, players, those conversations are happening for sure. People are calling LeBron, LeBron is calling people, but absolutely from an executive side, you are not getting those things.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James is not taking meetings, forcing teams to pitch him via podcasts
quotes.excerpt: LeBron isn't taking meetings, which is why Bob Myers had to go on a podcast and pitch
quotes.quote: They have made a point about the fact that LeBron isn't taking meetings, which is why Bob Myers had to go on a podcast and pitch LeBron James because he couldn't get a meeting with him. Chris Finch went on a podcast and pitched LeBron James because Chris Finch can't get a meeting with him. Nobody that we know of, according to Rich Paul, is meeting with LeBron. They are all talking to him, and then he talks to LeBron.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: The anger over LeBron James's previous move was about the process, not the destination
quotes.excerpt: It wasn't that he left Cleveland. That was not what that visceral reaction was about.
quotes.quote: I can tell you it wasn't that he left Cleveland. That was not what that visceral reaction was about. Yes, of course, if he had left Cleveland, people would have been upset. That's not what all that anger was about. It was the way it happened. It was that people, especially in Cleveland and to a degree around the country, felt this guy is playing with everyone's hopes, dreams, and emotions for fun because he wants the recruiting tour he never got, and he wants to be able to get on TV in front of everyone and hold the country's attention.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Atkinson's recent radio comments about free agency were inappropriate
quotes.excerpt: Kenny Atkinson, I feel, should be taking a moment to think about some of these interviews

text_blocks.speaker: Rachel Nichols
text_blocks.text: You had Kenny Atkinson go on the radio in Las Vegas and say, well, we could be getting a big change to our team, a free agent. I'd have to look up the exact quote, but I think you guys know what I'm talking about. A free agency thing could be coming. Dude, what are you doing? Who is letting him go on and say these things? Now you have set up a dynamic where if they don't get LeBron, he has now explained to everyone there's a hole in their team and that they needed him.

text_blocks.speaker: Chris Mannix
text_blocks.text: He enhances, I would say, the roster.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: The San Antonio Spurs make the most sense for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: San Antonio makes the most sense. You go to San Antonio, you get a guy that's been there
quotes.quote: San Antonio makes the most sense. You go to San Antonio, you get a guy that's been there, done that before. You get a guy that can teach you some things in the locker room. You are not signing him to a multi-year deal here. You are talking about a one-year deal. Getting LeBron to San Antonio helps them get over the mountain top. You get another killer in that locker room, someone that can educate these young stars on the roster and help them get to that next level.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James is a better team player than people realize
quotes.excerpt: LeBron is a better team player than people think he is. He makes his teammates better.
quotes.quote: I think LeBron is a better team player than people think he is. I think you just have to watch him out on the court. He did it again this season. He makes his teammates better. He is still one of the better passers and great court vision and all of the things. He plays the role you need him to play. He is generally a good influence on the younger teammates in the locker room. All of those things can be true and I am here to tell you they are true.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James is a gravitational force that disrupts any locker room
quotes.excerpt: He is a huge gravitational force and any locker room he is in becomes largely about LeBron James.
quotes.quote: He is a huge gravitational force and any locker room he is in becomes largely about LeBron James. That's not necessarily his fault. All the other things I just said before that are true, but it's just a fact. It comes along with him. I don't think that San Antonio locker room would be better off for that gravitational pull. I don't think all of the relentless media questions, again, not his fault, not Victor's fault, but the relentless of whose team is this now, is this LeBron's team, is this Victor's team?

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's five-year extension makes the Spurs a media focus
quotes.excerpt: Victor Wembanyama who just signed a five-year extension is 22 years old. You are high if you do not think
quotes.quote: Victor Wembanyama who just signed a five-year extension is 22 years old. You are high if you do not think there would not be a media frenzy if you do not think Victor would have to be asked all kinds of questions that are going to create some friction. If you do not think that the ingredient, when Rich Paul gets on his podcast and says, oh, if they hadn't won, it would have been New York, that would have been easy.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's perception is a living, active thing in the league
quotes.excerpt: The reality of LeBron and the perception of LeBron are two different things
quotes.quote: I think as I said, I think the reality of LeBron and the perception of LeBron are two different things, but the perception is an active, living thing also. And I just don't think the Spurs would do it. It's not that oh, it would be bad for Victor. I think as I said, I think the reality of LeBron and the perception of LeBron are two different things, but the perception is an active, living thing also. And I just don't think the Spurs would do it.
